issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Lecture attributes: The UML in the problem statement (class Lecture attributes with '-' prefix) and the solution implementation declare the lecture attributes as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The template implementation declares at least lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public fields. This mismatch (problem statement & solution: private vs. template: public) can confuse students whether to access fields directly or to implement and use getters/setters, and may lead to inconsistent student solutions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Lecture.java field declarations match the UML and the solution by changing the attribute declarations to private. Concretely, in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java replace 'public String lectureName;' and 'public int numberOfInscribedStudents;' with private declarations and ensure the template includes the other attributes (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) as private as well. Alternatively, if public fields were intended, update the UML/problem statement to show public attributes — preferred fix: change the template to private to align with UML and solution and to enforce use of getters/setters.
